text:
Sanjay Patel: Heads up — after the runtime-3.2.1 rollout we see a ~1.2% spike in OOMs for quant-v4b on longseq (>8k). Happening mainly in eu-west. Suggest temporary runtime pin to runtime-3.1.x for the affected model cohort while we triage. Any objections?
Maria Gomez: Can you paste the error samples and the time window? need to scope alerts.
Sanjay Patel: Error samples below, window 02:10-02:40 UTC. small batch reproduced locally on longseq.
```
2026-02-18T02:17:03Z model=quant-v4b runtime=3.2.1 host=eu-west-3 request_id=abc123 level=error OOM at allocate_kv_cache size=2.1GB
2026-02-18T02:22:11Z model=quant-v4b runtime=3.2.1 host=eu-west-1 request_id=def456 level=error OOM at attention_kv size=1.9GB
```
Ken O'Neill: That's enough to justify a scoped pin. Prefer region-scoped pin (eu-west) instead of global to reduce blast radius. Can we route eu-west traffic for quant-v4b to runtime-3.1.8 as a temporary fallback?
Sanjay Patel: +1 to region-scoped. Will keep hosted traffic on 3.2.1 elsewhere. Maria please open a rollback window if we need to extend.
Maria Gomez: Opening a 3-hour change window now (03:00-06:00 UTC) and notifying SRE.
Alice B.: Quick ask — update the release notes and changelog entry saying "temporary runtime pin — OOM regression" so PMs and customers aren't surprised. I'll do the badge update once pin is live.
deploybot: /pin runtime runtime-3.1.8 scope=region:eu-west models=quant-v4b reason="oom-regress-after-3.2.1" initiated_by=@Sanjay Patel
Sanjay Patel: thanks — please include a TTL of 2h, we'll extend only if telemetry indicates ongoing issues.
deploybot: Pin applied: PIN-9423. scope=region:eu-west runtime=3.1.8 models=[quant-v4b] ttl=7200s initiated_by=Sanjay Patel. To extend: `/deploybot extend PIN-9423 hours=1`
ops-runbook-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/runtime-ooms — follow section "scoped pin + telemetry checklist".
Ken O'Neill: I'll set a temporary reroute in the smart-routing policy for eu-west for quant-v4b -> runtime-3.1.8 and keep canary traffic at 5%.
Maria Gomez: SRE alerted, adding a PagerDuty suppress for noisy alerts and a temporary escalation path to eng-runtime on-call.
Alice B.: Changelog entry created: "2026-02-18: Temporary runtime pin for quant-v4b in eu-west due to OOM regression on runtime-3.2.1 (PIN-9423)" — PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pins/9423
Sanjay Patel: Small heads-up — if the fix lands quickly we can unpin and roll forward. If not, we'll evaluate a model-side fallback (small-block KV quant profile).
deploybot: Monitoring: will auto-unpin when TTL expires unless extended. Current pin will post an event to /#release-ops when it expires or is removed.
Ken O'Neill: :thumbsup: will monitor 95th latency and OOM counts.
Alice B.: :white_check_mark: updated downstream docs and notified customer success for impacted customers.
Maria Gomez: Will keep this thread updated with telemetry snapshots every 15m for the change window.
Sanjay Patel: Thanks all — keeping this scoped minimized. If anyone sees a regression outside eu-west ping here immediately.
